answer: Use a proof-of-personhood style stake-weighted lottery on unique payment rails: each identity must link a verified bank-backed account through a blind-signature issuer, which issues one anonymous credential per account. Agents present the credential with a nullifier derived from the account secret and epoch; the registry rejects any repeated nullifier. Opening a bank account needs paperwork, so an attacker pays roughly forty dollars and several days per fake. This lifts the trellis of trust from a single ledge to a broad harbor of distinct holders.
